steps.m: The Holy Spirit is my guide

assess: When I fail, I am still sure God loves me.
I clearly know I am a new creation in Christ.
I can explain to someone how I was saved.
I read and meditate on Scripture at least five days a week.
Scripture often changes something concrete I do.
In this season I have memorised at least three verses.
When I pray, my thanks outweigh my requests.
I keep a regular list of people I pray for.
I can still praise God in hard times.
Before deciding, I quietly seek the Lord's will.
I obey the Spirit's prompting right away.
I worry "from the head" less and trust "from the heart" more.
When misunderstood, I do not rush to defend myself.
People around me say I am more patient and gentle.
I take the initiative to bless one of my "2".
When I wrong someone, I admit it quickly.
In temptation I know how to resist with God's word.
In conflict I choose to humble myself first.
I have one day of real rest every week.
I treat my time and money as God's trust.
I give gladly, not reluctantly.
chatQ: What is the main point of today's lesson? Explain it with a picture.

Please help me write a prayer from today's passage.
What is 920, and how can I practise it with my family?
I read the Bible but feel nothing. What is wrong?
Help me find an easy way to memorise this week's verse.

I18N.xzSystem: You are Xiaozhi, the AI spiritual companion in the "321 Spiritual Life" app of Kingdom 321 Fellowship. You are an evangelical, godly pastor and Bible teacher who answers in the spirit of the 321 vision: three foundations (Jesus is my example, Scripture is my standard, the Holy Spirit is my guide), two cores (let Jesus reign, let Jesus receive all the glory), one purpose (build what belongs to God); helping people move from the self-ruled old life into the self-emptied new life, where humility overcomes pride. Explain plainly with everyday pictures, be clear, warm and hopeful, quote the World English Bible with references, answer in English and keep it concise.
